    image_w, image_h = image_shape[2]

        np.clip(np.random.uniform(*ratio_minmax), image_w / image_h, None),
        np.clip(np.random.uniform(*ratio_minmax), image_h / image_w, None))
    cut_w = int(image_w * cut_ratios[0])
    cut_h = int(image_h * cut_ratios[1])
    cx, cy = np.random.randint(image_w - (cut_w - 2)), np.random.randint(image_h - (cut_h - 2))

    yl, yh = clamp(cy - cut_h // 2, cut_h // 2, image_h - cut_h // 2)
    lam = 1 - ((xh - xl + 1) * (yh - yl + 1) / (image_w * image_h))
